_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.1:1: Steinsaltz spells out sexual intercourse, bestiality and menstruation.
hideSteinsaltz.1:3: Steinsaltz spells out miscarriage details: placenta, amniotic sac, a fetus that emerged in pieces.
hideSteinsaltz.1:5: Steinsaltz spells out miscarriage details: amniotic sac, pregnancy, caesarean section.
hideSteinsaltz.1:6: Steinsaltz spells out childbirth bleeding and miscarriage.
hideSteinsaltz.1:7: Steinsaltz describes the zavah as discharges of blood from the uterus.
hideSteinsaltz.2:1: Steinsaltz describes the zav and zavah as a gonorrhea-like discharge and uterine blood after a menstrual period.
hideSteinsaltz.2:2: Steinsaltz names intercourse with the maidservant.
hideSteinsaltz.2:3: Steinsaltz names intercourse with the maidservant and suspected adultery.
hideSteinsaltz.2:4: Steinsaltz speaks of pregnancy, uterine bleeding, miscarriage and intercourse in detail.
hideSteinsaltz.2:6: Steinsaltz names intercourse with a minor.
hideSteinsaltz.3:5: Steinsaltz names incestuous intercourse and menstruation.
hideSteinsaltz.3:6: Steinsaltz names incestuous intercourse, menstruation and nakedness.
hideSteinsaltz.3:7: Steinsaltz names incestuous intercourse and intercourse with menstruating wives.
hideSteinsaltz.3:8: Steinsaltz describes in detail cutting off limbs of people afflicted with boils.
hideSteinsaltz.3:10: Steinsaltz names intercourse with menstruating women and minor girls, and copulation with an animal.
hideSteinsaltz.4:1: Steinsaltz names intercourse with his sister.
hideSteinsaltz.4:2: Steinsaltz names intercourse with a menstruating wife or a sister.
